title: E is for Eden — God's Beautiful Garden
memory_verse: "God planted a garden in Eden." — Genesis 2:8
objective: Students will learn the letter E and the Bible word Eden, the beautiful garden God made for Adam and Eve.
content: Today we are learning the letter E! Can you say E? E is for Eden!
The Garden of Eden was the most beautiful garden ever! God planted it Himself. It had pretty flowers, yummy fruit trees, and friendly animals everywhere.
God made the Garden of Eden for Adam and Eve to live in. He wanted them to be happy and to take care of it. God gives us good things because He loves us!
activity: Color a picture of the letter E. Draw a beautiful garden with flowers, trees, and animals like the Garden of Eden.
discussion: Can you say the letter E?
What was the name of God's beautiful garden?
What kinds of things were in the Garden of Eden?
